description: Source file for hardware initialization and management in an embedded automotive system, including SPI, I2C, ADC, and peripheral setup.

methods.name: lockSpi
methods.description: Locks the SPI bus for exclusive access to a device.

methods.name: initSpiModules
methods.description: Initializes SPI modules based on configuration.

methods.name: getSpiDevice
methods.description: Returns the SPI driver instance for a given device.

methods.name: initI2Cmodule
methods.description: Initializes the I2C bus and configures pins.

methods.name: sendI2Cbyte
methods.description: Sends a byte over I2C (commented out in code).

methods.name: adc_callback_fast
methods.description: ADC callback for fast ADC sampling, processes ADC data.

methods.name: calcFastAdcIndexes
methods.description: Calculates ADC index mappings based on engine configuration.

methods.name: adcConfigListener
methods.description: Updates ADC indexes when configuration changes.

methods.name: turnOnHardware
methods.description: Turns on hardware components like trigger input pins.

methods.name: unregisterPin
methods.description: Unregisters a pin if it differs from previous.

methods.name: stopSpi
methods.description: Stops SPI device and unmarks related pins.

methods.name: applyNewHardwareSettings
methods.description: Applies new hardware configuration, stops/starts peripherals accordingly.

methods.name: initHardware
methods.description: Main hardware initialization routine, sets up peripherals, configuration, and system components.
